message.content:
Sure! If you're looking for a **machine**—i.e., a piece of equipment—to bake a chocolate cake from scratch, here’s a quick rundown of your best options:

| Machine | Why It Works Well for Chocolate Cake | Typical Baking Time & Temperature |
|---------|--------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
| **Conventional Oven** | Most people already own one. Gives great control over temperature and browning. | Pre‑heat to ≈ 350 °F (180 °C). Bake 25–35 min depending on size/pan. |
| **Convection Oven** | Uses fan‑circulated heat → more even cooking, slightly shorter time. | Same temp but reduce by 20–25 °F (~10 °C) and check earlier. |
| **Toaster Oven / Compact Convection Oven** | Great for small cakes or when you don’t want to heat up a full-size oven. | Similar temps; watch closely because it heats faster. |
| **Air Fryer (with baking basket)** | Quick, energy efficient, produces nice crust without much oil. | Set to 320 °F (160 °C); bake 15–18 min. |
| **Instant Pot® + Air Fryer Lid** | Combines pressure cooking and crisping; good for moist texture. | Cook “cake” setting for 5 min under high pressure, then switch to air fry for 8–12 min. |
| **Smart Oven (e.g., June Oven, Tovala Smart Oven)** | Auto‑detects moisture, adjusts heat automatically. | Follow app presets – usually around 325 °F (165 °C) for 28–32 min. |
| **Thermomix™ / KitchenAid Artisan Food Processor** | Built‑in heating element plus mixing bowl makes prep easy. | Use “bake” function at 170 °C for 30–40 min. |

### How to Pick:
* **Size matters:** A standard 9×13 inch pan fits most home ovens. For smaller appliances, choose a round 7‑inch pan or loaf tin.
* **Heat distribution:** Convection fans give uniform results; if you’re unsure, stick with a conventional oven.
* **Convenience vs. Control:** Smart ovens automate many steps but may cost more. Traditional ovens offer full manual control.

---

#### Quick Recipe Snapshot (for a Conventional Oven)

```text
Ingredients:
• 2 cups all-purpose flour
• ¾ cup unsweetened cocoa powder
• 2 tsp baking soda
• ½ tsp salt
• 1 cup sugar
• 1 egg + ¼ cup milk
• ⅓ cup vegetable oil
• 1 tbsp vanilla extract
• 1 cup boiling water

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350 °F (180 °C).
2. Grease a 9x13-inch pan.
3. In a bowl, whisk together dry ingredients.
4. Add wet ingredients except water; beat until smooth.
5. Stir in hot water slowly (be careful—it will bubble).
6. Pour batter into prepared pan.
7. Bake 25–30 minutes; test with toothpick.
8. Cool before frosting.
```

Feel free to swap out the oven above for any other listed machine—you’ll get similar results with slight tweaks to time/temp. Happy baking!
